verdict.rationale: Persona is an identity-verification and compliance platform (APIs, inquiry flows, workflows, reports), not an AI agent or assistant. Acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is outside its product role, and nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. Its workflows can 'ingest non-Persona, 3rd party data', but that is an adjacent integration feature, not MCP client support, so it does not make this axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
